description: Replacement windows to front, rear and side elevations.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan, ref: PP-15055664v1Site PlanExisting Elevations, dated 27.06.26Proposed Elevations, dated 27.06.26Technical Guide: Ovolo 70mm Open Out WindowTechnical Guide: Flush Casement WindowTechnical Guide: Sash Windows Section Detail, ref: V01-2017Proposed Window ScheduleReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Unless otherwise specified in the application the materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted along with work of making good shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building.  Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the development respects the appearance, existing materials and built and natural features of the surrounding area.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), no windows, doors, rooflights, dormer windows or other openings shall be inserted into the external elevations or roof slopes of the development hereby approved other than those expressly shown on the approved plans, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To safeguard the privacy, outlook and residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy 30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policy DMD 8 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
